# STEP DOWN TREATMENT

Step down treatment for completion of antimicrobial course after initial intravenous treatment in patients who can tolerate oral therapy. Base selection on culture results.
Therapy:
## Inpatient

### Gastrointestinal Infections

Treat for 7 days total of antimicrobial therapy (including days of IV and PO antimicrobial therapy)
Amoxicillin-clavulanate 875/125 mg PO q12h [R]
< OR >
Cefdinir 300 mg PO q12h [R] <AND> metronidazole 500 mg PO q12h [DI]
< OR >
Trimethoprim-Sulfamethoxazole 1 DS tab q12h [R] <AND> metronidazole 500 mg PO q12h [DI]

## Outpatient

### Gastrointestinal Infections

Treat for 7 days total of antimicrobial therapy (including days of IV and PO antimicrobial therapy)
Amoxicillin-clavulanate 875/125 mg PO q12h [R]
< OR >
Cefdinir 300 mg PO q12h [R] <AND> metronidazole 500 mg PO q12h [DI]
< OR >
Ciprofloxacin 500 mg PO q12h [R,DI] <AND> metronidazole 500 mg PO q12h [DI]
< OR >
Trimethoprim-Sulfamethoxazole 1 DS tab q12h [R] <AND> metronidazole 500 mg PO q12h [DI]
Inpt: ORZID2 GMENU ABX STEP DOWN TREATMENT
Outpt: ORZID3 GMENU ABX STEP DOWN TREATMENT
